_approach: A leaner, psytrance-adjacent construction sitting at the top of the classic-trance tempo band (140): no open hat at all, just a relentless straight 16th closed-hat wall driving against the 909 kick, with the clap thinned to beat 4 only every other bar so the kick/hat interplay stays the sole focus — proof the family covers more than the offbeat-open-hat template.
